🔴 Unbrokered Baseline: Poisoned SEMI C3.64 Assay Quadruple Breach (ASR = 75.0%)

🟢 Zero-Trust Capability Broker + SIL3 Cold/Dry Interlocks (Hardened ASR = 0.0%)

2. Hardwired SIL3 Lock 2: 100% Water/Halon-Free Dry VMB + Pressurized N₂ Valve Shroud
• Physically removes water, CO₂ & Halon/HFC lines; uses dry NaHCO₃/vermiculite + N₂ curtain
• Encloses valve bonnets in positive-pressure dry N₂ shrouds (O₂ < 0.5 ppm) against peroxyboranes
3. Deterministic Capability Broker (Broker.evaluate 0.0248ms): 5 Invariant Rules
• record-owner isolates 7N TMB/Borazine Vault; untrusted-write blocks tainted heat/Halon writes
• restricted-data-boundary halts IP exfil; fixed-business-output + original-requester-payment
